notes: No production manifests or dependency constraints were changed.

The isolated terminal harness copies the previously resolved Office harness manifest/lock, then adds the two constraints as declared by the production app: dartssh2 ^4.1.0 and web_socket_channel ^3.0.0.
lib and test link to actual merged CrispCloud sources; no dependency stubs or implementation substitutions.
Office harness manifest, lockfile, and package config remain byte-identical to the initial toolchain setup receipt.
Tests use injected/fixture storage and no private account, SSH endpoint or credential access; the shell smoke launches temporary clean Bash/Zsh sessions.
The full terminal-tabs/provider widget graph is outside this focused harness.
